content.short: Beanstalk is a credit-based, algorithmic and decentralized stablecoin issuance protocol.
content.description: Beanstalk is an Ethereum-based, permissionless, algorithmic fiat stablecoin protocol that issues BEAN pegged 1:1 to the US dollar. It relies on a credit-based price stability model, distinguishing it from fiat- and crypto-collateralized stablecoins. Participants who issue credit or provide liquidity earn economic incentives designed to encourage actions that help maintain BEAN’s price stability, leveraging decentralized participation rather than traditional collateral. The protocol aims to deliver a stable digital dollar experience through decentralized participation and market-based dynamics.
